name: gamedev
description: Game engine tooling for Claude Code. One plugin per engine, each a container for whatever skills that engine accumulates.

plugins.name: unreal
plugins.description: Unreal Engine tooling. Skills for driving the editor from outside it and for performance work: reproducible stat baselines, bottleneck diagnosis, ranked optimizations, and automated before/after screenshot comparison captured from pinned git commits.

plugins.name: unity
plugins.description: Unity tooling. Skills for driving a live Editor through the com.unity.pipeline bridge — its typed tool catalog, the field failures that are not in anyone's docs, and a verified baseline — plus keeping all of it current as the CLI, the package and Unity's own official skills shift underneath it. Complements Unity-Technologies/skills rather than duplicating it.
